platform: meeting recording (video call with screen share, Wikidata/Phabricator)

files.speech: speech (en), checked on a 2-min sample from 600 s

description: Bug Triage Hour at Wikidata WikiProjects Days 2026: participants bring problems, the team reproduces them and files or updates Phabricator tickets.
expected_report: Per discussed problem: what was shown on screen, which ticket was created or updated and with which tags, who raised it, what was decided vs only proposed.
difficulty: Long meeting, several speakers, small browser text in screen share.
